facts.fact: SPIN's director-general says SPIN operates a fibre backbone from Libreville along the Transgabonais railway to Franceville, on to Bakoumba and Makokou and up to Cameroon via Booue, about 2,000 km in all, with two of the nine provinces not yet connected.

GAB.note: Planned 2,000 km extension awaits financing; no capacity sale stated.

facts.fact: SPIN's director-general says a SPIN subsidiary manages the landing of the ACE submarine cable and that the backbone gives Gabon physical interconnections with Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea and Congo, though cross-border traffic stays low.
facts.system: ACE submarine cable and cross-border backbone links
